result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is one notable inconsistency: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab for the content being displayed. No other significant visual defects were found beyond minor cosmetic observations.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar highlights 'Profile' (green icon and label) even though the screen currently displayed is the Home feed (delivery address, search bar, promotions, restaurant lists). The 'Home' tab should be the active/highlighted one.
issues.suggestion: Fix the active-tab state logic so the tab corresponding to the visible screen (Home) is highlighted, and 'Profile' remains in its inactive gray state.

issues.description: Restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' section show delivery time and fee but no ratings, while the 'Popular right now' card shows a rating (4.8, 500+). This inconsistency reduces comparability across sections.
issues.suggestion: Display ratings consistently across all restaurant cards, or intentionally document/design the difference between compact and expanded card formats.
